scope: Frozen export repair: owner and accepted-erasure boundaries, one-item singleflight/cache, repeated transfer callbacks, JSON/CSV selection and user-saved copies.

verifiedSourceBehavior.observation: Copies of one JSON Transferable retain the same preparation reference. Concurrent loads share a pending task; successful repeats reuse its Document. Every access checks the captured owner, including before caching/returning an awaited value. Identity-matched pending cleanup cannot erase a newer task. Failed loads are not cached and can retry.

Snapshot generation and owner guard both JSON and CSV writes on MainActor. Sign-out, confirmed deletion and cold signed-out recovery clear the account snapshot and app-managed staging before stale future writes can succeed. Accepted deletion tears down synchronously before provider sign-out await.

JSON exposes only .json and CSV only .commaSeparatedText, using distinct Transferable types. CSV has a fixed .csv filename and local payload; it never calls /me/export. Profile selects the corresponding type. Suspended account export uses the same guarded JSON type.
Cleanup targets only app-managed temporary staging and legacy export-prefixed temporary entries. It does not traverse Documents or arbitrary destination URLs, so copies saved by users remain theirs.

Tests assert concurrent/repeated coalescing, failure then retry, stale cached access and owner change during await. The review inspected their assertions only; it did not run them or infer real ShareLink callback behavior.

boundaries: The cache is per Transferable item, not a global per-account export cache. A recreated view/item starts a new preparation. Separate requested exports still consume the existing server allowance.

Singleflight coalesces application loads; it does not suppress APIClient transport retries. The configured default remains three HTTP export requests per hour, and errors permit a later retry. Actual Files journeys must measure request counts.

Erasure preparation/uncertain hold does not itself revoke AccountLocalStore or clear temporary exports. An already-issued same-owner cached transfer is not explicitly canceled at that boundary. Confirmed deletion/sign-out does revoke and clear it; no A-to-B exposure or runtime hold-path exposure was reproduced by this review.
User-saved copies intentionally survive app account cleanup; this is not a promise to revoke files already delivered to external destinations.
Static review is not runtime/compiler qualification, live erasure proof, production ShareLink behavior, physical-device verification or archive17 approval.
